payout_quote: 2026 Poll Worker Manual: 'Poll workers generally work a full day, from about 6 AM to 8:30 PM. ... Compensation ranges from $115 to $350, depending on the role and shift.' Official poll-worker FAQ: 'The pay ranges from $225/day to $350/day, depending on the role served. The amount paid includes Election Day work and attendance of an in-person training session.' Official training presentation: 'Most poll workers are paid $225 for a full day or $115 for a half day; Judges of Election are paid $300 for working the day and $50 for delivery of election materials.'
steps: Be a registered voter in Montgomery County; not a current public officeholder/government employee; not a candidate on the ballot (except as Judge/Inspector of Election).
Apply/contact Montgomery County Voter Services when an opening exists (elected positions filled every four years; clerks/machine operators appointed).
Attend one in-person training session (training takes less than 2 hours).
Work Election Day, generally 6 AM to 8:30 PM; Judge of Election picks up and delivers election materials.
catches: Election-period work only; openings depend on vacancies — Judge/Inspectors are elected every four years and appoint their own clerks/machine operators.
Pay includes Election Day work plus in-person training attendance; must sign the pay sheet on Election Day.
Must be a registered voter in Montgomery County and remain nonpartisan on Election Day.
Cannot vote at your own precinct during the workday unless a mail ballot was requested.
biggest_catch: Openings are scarce — Judges and Inspectors are elected every four years and appoint their own clerks and machine operators, so placement depends on vacancies.
eligibility: Registered voter in Montgomery County; not a public officeholder/government employee (current or within last two months); not a candidate on the ballot.
timing: Pay timing not stated on the official pages.

c1.evidence: Montgomery County PA (montgomerycountypa.gov) — 2026 Poll Worker Manual, FAQ, and training presentation.

c2.evidence: Official 2026 pay: $225/day full day to $350 (Judge of Election $300 + $50 materials delivery); most workers $225/full day. Half-day $115 excluded from this full-day framing.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

s4.note: Concrete: $225-$350/day full-day per official 2026 FAQ/manual; half-day $115 excluded from this framing.

s6.note: Steps concrete: county application, in-person training, full-day Election Day service.
